text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the overcast skies are going to 
stick around...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
How did all the Tiara Umamusume bounce 
back at times like this, I wonder...
choice_data_list:
Even the most incredible people have off 
days.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
choice_data_list: どんなにすごい人にも調子が悪い時はある
choice_data_list_en: Even the most incredible people have their off days.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
choice_data_list: 君の努力は決して彼女たちに負けていない
貴方の努力は決して彼女たちに負けていない
みんながむしゃらに走り続けてきたんだ
みんながむしゃらに走り続けてきたんだよ
choice_data_list_en: Your efforts don't fall short of theirs in the slightest.
Your hard work is in no way second to theirs.
Everyone just kept running their hearts out with all they had.
Everyone just kept running with everything they had, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hard work will always answer in kind. I 
urged them to believe that time will come 
and keep pushing forward without giving 
up.

choice_data_list_en: Your efforts don't fall short of theirs in the slightest.
Your hard work is in no way second to theirs.

Everyone just kept running with everything they had, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I'm starting to feel a little 
braver now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to be timid.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trusting in the path I've walked, I'll 
take on the next challenge!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone keeps running, gritting their 
teeth through defeat. Because if you stop, 
your path ends right there—she gently 
reminded them.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Never giving up"... that's what it really 
means, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, through the break in the 
clouds... I feel like I can see a little 
bit of light.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
In order not to lose... I need to train 
even harder and more than before!
